title: Batch Artifact Metadata
description: Field-for-field the sibling TOC pack's ../UNIVERSAL_TOC_PIPELINE_PACK_V2_FINAL/00_PIPELINE_CORE/schemas/artifact_metadata.schema.json, with path_id replaced by batch_id. Every glossary stage output that isn't itself a cross-batch registry (concept_evidence_registry.json, video_bank/approved_segments.json, source_pack.json) requires this under 'metadata', same discipline as every per-run TOC artifact requiring artifact_metadata.schema.json.
